correctness.rationale: Exact construction of the Petersen canonical double cover is checked graph-isomorphic to GP(10,3). The complete 6212-face list (not sampling), 3103 disjoint matches and all 30380 Hasse incidences are independently reconstructed. A directed topological ordering processes all 6212 nodes, proving acyclicity. Exactly one critical vertex, one 4-cell and five 5-cells remain. Unit-pivot cancellation with signed boundary incidences yields five zero integer Morse coefficients, so each 5-cell attaches to the single 4-sphere with degree zero; pi_4(S^4)=Z gives the claimed homotopy wedge. Original mod-two homology is independently computed and corroborates the cell counts. The supplied verifier executes without additional packages.

value.rationale: The Desargues graph is a canonical cubic bipartite graph, simultaneously the Petersen Kronecker double cover and bipartite Kneser H(5,2). The 2026 Mycielskian homotopy theorem explicitly needs its independence complex as a missing natural input. The exact mixed-dimensional homotopy classification yields integer homology and null attaching maps not deducible from the existing linear-strand edge-ideal results or other graph-family theorems. A complete 20-vertex naturally named finite case has coherent standalone mathematical value; it does not claim an unmotivated slice, trivial substitution or larger family theorem.
